# A picker editor's trigger click ends the grid cell edit

## Context

Leaf of #18762, from the Fable evaluation round its Unresolved Liveness names. Measured on `examples/grid/cellEditing` at `dev@3f859a4803` with a real pointer and keyboard. Text and number editors complete the whole loop; the date editor does not survive a pointer on its trigger.

Owner: @neo-fable (self-assigned 2026-09-18).

## The Problem

**Observed**

Double-click a `Random Date` cell → the DateField editor mounts and takes focus. Click its picker trigger → the editor is destroyed, no picker stays, `document.activeElement` is `body`. A date can only be typed.

**Measured mechanism** (worker-side focus trace + a main-thread `focusin`/`focusout`/mutation trace)

The trigger click opens the picker, and the DateSelector takes focus. `manager.Focus#focusMove` reports the move as a leave for `[datefield, row, body, view]` and then an enter for `[dateselector, picker]`. The plugin commits on the editor's `focusLeave`, so `completeEdit()` destroys the editor and the picker with it, and focus falls to `body`.

A second defect sits behind the first. Once the session survives a picker visit, the editor's last focus enter came from the picker, so `component.Base#revertFocus` hands focus to a component that dies with the editor: ending the edit leaves focus on `body` instead of `grid.View`.

**Corrected 2026-09-18:** the first filing also listed "a ComboBox trigger click does not open the list". Under Playwright it does — 243 items, the input keeps focus, an item click selects, the session stays. That sighting was an artifact of the preview browser's click; the ComboBox keeps focus in its input, so it never crosses the island boundary. It stays here as a witness arm only.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs` — `editor.on('focusLeave', …)` commits whenever the session is embodied.
- `src/manager/Focus.mjs` — `focusMove` delivers the leave set before the enter set, synchronously; `setComponentFocus` writes `containsFocus` before it fires the events.
- `src/form/field/Picker.mjs` — the picker container is `parentId: 'document.body'` with NO `parentComponent`. `ComponentManager.getParentPath` — the path `manager.Focus` works on — walks `component.parent` (`parentComponent`, else `parentId`), so the picker is a branch of its own, outside the editor's path. That is the root cause; `button.Base`, the tab overflow control and the grid component column give their floating parts `parentComponent`.
- `src/component/Base.mjs` — `revertFocus()` reads `focusEnterData.relatedTarget`, overwritten on every focus enter.
- D#17832 OQ5, resolved and assigned to the interaction-contract responsibility, never filed as a leaf: "Focus leaves the editor/picker island → commit-if-valid", "Escape with picker open → close picker only".

## The Fix

**Revised 2026-09-18, on @tobiu's question on the PR** (would editors carrying parent ids simplify it): in `src/form/field/Picker.mjs`, `createPicker` gives the picker `parentComponent: me`. Focus moving between input and picker is then a move inside the field — no `focusLeave` for the field, the Row or the grid, and `focusEnterData` keeps its origin — so the grid plugin needs no change, and the field's two scans of the focus payload (for the picker's id, and for its own) are deleted. Every picker field gains it, not only grid editors.

~~First prescription, built and approved before the question: a plugin-side island — the leave terminal deferred by a microtask and asking `containsFocus` on editor and picker, a listener on the picker, and a restored focus origin on the session.~~ It worked around a picker that was nobody's child.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Clicking a DateField editor's trigger opens the date picker and the session stays embodied; a picked day reaches the record when focus then leaves the island.
- [ ] Escape with the picker open closes the picker and keeps the session; a second Escape cancels, and focus is on `grid.View`.
- [ ] Focus leaving the editor AND its picker still commits a valid draft (the existing click-away and focus-leave arms stay green).
- [ ] ~~Witness: a ComboBox editor's trigger opens its list inside the session, and Escape closes the list before it cancels.~~ Moved to #18839: any arm opening the Country editor can red on that ticket's renderer error (`reading 'name'` of null, 1 of 4 runs), so the witness lands with its fix.
- [ ] CI-executed e2e arms on the public example (in #18837's spec), the two date arms red on `dev` first; each half of the fix killed by a named mutation.
- [ ] Enter after a picker visit commits and leaves focus on `grid.View` (added 2026-09-18, once #18850's engine guard was on `dev`: the flow needs both fixes).

## Out of Scope

Tab/Shift+Tab traversal, select-on-activation, S3 opt-out, the IME probe (remaining interaction-contract scope, #18861–#18865) · ComboBox on a bound store (#18839) · whether a picker field should open its picker on Enter while it is a grid editor — the picker still flashes into the DOM for ~9 ms on an Enter-commit.

## Avoided Traps

- **A timer, or a plugin-side "picker is open" flag, to skip the commit:** the focus manager already knows where focus is; a second notion of "inside" drifts from it.
- **Reading the leave event's `oldPath`:** for a focus move it carries the path focus went TO, for a plain leave the path it came FROM — one name, two meanings. `containsFocus` after the move has landed means one thing.
- **Parenting the picker into the Row:** the body clips it, and it dies with the pool slot.
